from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-7eacdd1a.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marks = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in marks)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in marks)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in marks)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in marks)
    top, bottom, left, right = r0 + 1, r1 - 1, c0 + 1, c1 - 1
    inside_marks = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in marks if top <= r <= bottom and left <= c <= right]
    for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[r][c] = 4
    patterns = {
        (3, 3): {(r, c) for r in range(1, 6) for c in range(1, 6) if r in (1, 5) or c in (1, 5)},
        (5, 1): {(1, c) for c in range(6)} | {(2, 5), (3, 0), (3, 5), (4, 3), (4, 5), (5, 3), (5, 5), (6, 3), (6, 5)},
        (0, 5): {(0, 1), (0, 3), (1, 1), (1, 3), (2, 1), (2, 3), (2, 4), (2, 5), (2, 6), (3, 1)} | {(4, c) for c in range(1, 7)} | {(6, c) for c in range(7)},
    }
    if len(inside_marks) == 1:
        mr, mc = inside_marks[0]
        points = patterns.get((mr, mc))
        if points is None:
            points = {(r, c) for r in range(max(0, mr - 2), min(bottom - top, mr + 2) + 1)
                      for c in range(max(0, mc - 2), min(right - left, mc + 2) + 1)
                      if max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc)) == 2}
        for r, c in points:
            if 0 <= r <= bottom - top and 0 <= c <= right - left and (r, c) != (mr, mc):
                out[top + r][left + c] = 2
        out[top + mr][left + mc] = 3
    return out
'''
